description: decimal.div rounds the exact quotient to the places asked, in each mode.
program:
(let [n (decimal.from-int 1) m (decimal.from-int -2) three (decimal.from-int 3)
      modes [HalfEven HalfUp Down Up Floor Ceiling]]
  [(map (fn [r] (decimal.show (decimal.div n three 2 r))) modes)
   (map (fn [r] (decimal.show (decimal.div m three 1 r))) modes)
   (map (fn [r] (decimal.show (decimal.div (decimal.from-int 5) (decimal.from-int 2) 0 r))) modes)
   (decimal.show (decimal.div (decimal.from-int 10) (decimal.from-int 4) 5 HalfEven))
   (decimal.show (decimal.div (decimal.from-int 0) (decimal.from-int -4) 2 Up))])
